title: Keep widget settings aligned after duplicating a page
steps: Inspect Overview: Right is the visible widget, Left is collapsed in the tray, and the creator panel shows Right.
Choose Duplicate from the Overview page menu and save Overview (copy); inspect the visible widget and the creator panel.

video_guide.summary: Duplicate Overview and inspect the copied page’s Right widget and its settings title.

chapters.note: Overview shows Left in the collapsed tray, a visible Right table with a green active border, and Widget title Right in the side panel.

chapters.label: Choose Duplicate page from the Overview page menu.

chapters.note: The Duplicate page dialog shows Overview (copy) with Save and Cancel buttons.
Overview (copy) is selected; Right is visible with a green active border, Left remains in the tray, and the side panel reads Widget title Right.
The copied page still shows the visible Right widget beside Widget title Right.
